hypothesis: White dwarfs are passive burners: Mestel cooling L ~ T^(7/2) with stored energy F ~ T gives the burn law P ~ F^(7/2). The A4 lifetime tau = integral dF/P(F) and the abundance law N ~ b tau then predict the luminosity-function slope d log10 N / d Mbol = 2/7 in the Mestel range. Path-A test of the abundance law for a passive burner in astronomy.

observable.quantity: slope of log10 Phi versus Mbol
observable.domain: SDSS DA white dwarfs, Mbol 6.0-13.5 (Hu, Wu and Wu 2007)

prediction_method.description: n = 3.5 from L ~ T^(7/2) and F ~ T; slope = 0.4 (n-1)/n; compared with the observed linear-fit slope using the path-A ratio rule

fixed_parameters: constant formation rate over the cooling times concerned
fail_criterion: FAILED if |log10(predicted/observed)| > 0.3; INCONCLUSIVE between 0.1 and 0.3 or if the registered value disagrees with the journal text.
note: Disclosure: drafted after reading the source, which itself states that the fitted slope 0.32 is almost identical to the Mestel slope 2/7; the outcome is effectively known. The Mestel law is borrowed physics (synthesis audit); this card tests that the UET burn-law lifetime plus abundance law reproduce it, not a new prediction. No slope uncertainty is quoted. The path-A ratio rule (|log10| <= 0.1 PASS, <= 0.3 INCONCLUSIVE) was fixed for T007 before this card was drafted. Approved by the author on 2026-11-10 as drafted.
